description: This file defines the UserService class implementing user management functionalities such as loadUserByUsername, createUser, listUsers, updateUserRoles, deleteUser, and role name retrieval. It integrates with Spring Security for authentication and role handling within a Java backend.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class implementing user management and authentication integration with Spring Security, supporting user creation, retrieval, updating roles, and deletion.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details for Spring Security authentication based on email username.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a user account by email, returning an Optional<UserAccount>.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified email, password, and full name, encoding the password and assigning a default role.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of all user accounts.

methods.name: updateUserRoles
methods.description: Updates roles for a user identified by ID based on the provided role update request.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes the user identified by the given ID.

methods.name: getRoleNames
methods.description: Returns the set of role names assigned to a user account.
